reviewer: Home-B website_686_687; independent of the source/test author
review_kind: Independent source and recorded-evidence review; no duplicate test execution
decision: PASS after one independently identified cancellation-state defect was repaired

resolved_finding.initial_behavior: PipelineWorker cancellation before start emits finished(False) without an error. The initial screen only cleared _dino_running on success or job_failed, leaving controls disabled and is_busy true after thread retirement.
resolved_finding.reproduction: The author used the requested actual make_thread wrapper to call worker.request_cancel before start. The backend is forbidden; active/pending counts reach zero, but the initial is_busy assertion fails.
resolved_finding.repair: Connect job_finished to _on_dino_finished. Restore controls only on unsuccessful terminal completion while the screen remains open, owns a running state, and has no newer pending job. Existing error and successful completion paths retain their messages.
resolved_finding.stale_terminal_protection: The author regression starts a new real-thread retry from the old job_failed signal before its old terminal(False). The newer pending job prevents the old terminal signal from clearing the new running state.
resolved_finding.validation_readback: Recorded baseline: 1 failed, 11 deselected in 2.35s. Corrected owning four-module cohort: 33 passed in 5.98s; command terminal exit 0; no skipped/failed tests reported.

reviewed_contracts: The actual ALPHA_FEATURES[561] registry includes both the existing pretrain button and the new container, so its picker, epoch control and progress bar follow the alpha switch.
Checkpoint selection handles cancellation and missing files; it selects a path without decoding or training, and compares canonical paths to reuse an existing entry.
GUI epoch control defaults to 20 and passes the selected total; programmatic default and captured channel policy are preserved.
The separate JobRunner isolates its pending/error state. Sharing APP_KEY only labels separate RunRegistry handle objects; it does not merge jobs.
Progress is emitted from the backend callback and applied through a GUI-bound receiver; current generation, running and closed checks reject stale reports.
Success selects the output checkpoint and restores controls. Error restores controls while retaining its message; later progress is ignored. No-error cancellation now also restores controls.
is_busy includes active DINO worker retirement in addition to the DINO running flag, crop loading and other runner jobs.
Close sets crop stop and DINO closed/generation state before bounded shutdown of both runners. Parked-worker callbacks cannot update the closed screen, and deleted-signal RuntimeError is caught.
limitations: No backend model deserialization, training, model-quality benchmark, GPU or native platform acceptance performed.
No duplicate test run by this reviewer; reported pass/fail results are independently read from the author committed logs.
Single local-path isfile/realpath checks remain on the GUI thread; no directory scan was added and no concrete responsiveness regression was established.
Direct screen close retains bounded shutdown semantics and can consume two default 3-second runner budgets. Existing JobRunner journal=False behavior was not changed by this patch.
Runtime translations and normal API generation have separate owners; this source review is not whole F561 acceptance.
